The '''Curamel Intergalactic Spaceport''', also known as the '''Calamar Intergalactic Spaceport''' or simply the '''Calamar Spaceport''', was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].

==History==
It was the location where [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] docked [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] during his pursuit of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] and [[Hurlo Holowan]]. It was also the location where [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] head [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] and his son [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] were stationed in pursuit of the same individuals. Bossk captured [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] who had left ''Slave I'', but not the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], while looking for a scrap piece of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. The young Fett was eventually recovered by his father on the ship of Cradossk.

Upon returning to the vessel, the Fetts were greeted by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who was in disguise as an old woman. Wesell joined the Fetts on their ship and took a subcontract to hunt Holowan. Wesell then commandeered a [[StarNailer-class fighter|''StarNailer''-class fighter]] from the space station and piloted it toward [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

[[Jatz/Legends|Jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]] once awaited the processing of his immigration visa to the planet at Calamar Spaceport.<ref name="GNN6">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
